The repository **cupcakke/royal** is a public project written primarily in **Zig** and configured with `uv` / Python tooling.

## Repository Overview
- **Repository URL**: github.com/cupcakke/royal
- **Primary Language**: Zig
- **Default Branch**: `main`

## Project Structure
The repository contains the following components in its directory tree:

- `src/core` & `src/core_relational`: Core computation and data structures
- `src/distributed`: Distributed execution components
- `src/hw`: Hardware-level integrations and acceleration
- `src/index` & `src/ranker`: Indexing and ranking modules
- `src/inference_server_main.zig`: Inference server entrypoint
- `src/main_distributed_futhark.zig`: Distributed Futhark integration and execution pipeline
- `src/optimizer` & `src/processor`: Query/data processing and optimization routines
- `src/tokenizer` & `tokenizer.vocab`: Tokenization modules and vocabulary
- `src/zk`: Zero-knowledge related components
- `build.zig` & `build.zig.zon`: Zig build orchestration
- `pyproject.toml` & `uv.lock`: Python environment configuration
